article.title: Fighting Zombie Laws: Inside Fund Texas Choice v. Deski
article.author: Ja'Loni Owens
article.content: Soon after Paxton's advisory, many Texas abortion funds went dark. One by one, the organizations that made up the Texas abortion access network stopped answering requests, stopped booking travel, and stopped funding healthcare. Read more via Scalawag : Fighting Zombie Laws: Inside Fund Texas Choice v. Deski .
